observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage in a public plaza at night, with an illuminated church facade in the background
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, approximately 10 dancers forming couples
observation.formation_and_space: group arranged in a loose horizontal line across the stage, pairing up into couples, turning and moving across the stage space
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture with weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: rapid alternating foot stamps and heel taps synchronized with the upbeat tempo
observation.arms_and_hands: men hold their hands behind their backs or grip their jacket sides, women continuously manipulate and swirl the wide ruffles of their heavy multi-colored skirts, occasionally lifting them high or holding their charro hats
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and relatively still while lower body and arms are in constant motion
observation.partnering: couples dance in proximity, circling each other and kneeling down in pairs without continuous hand-to-hand contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent spinning turns of women showcasing their skirts, couples kneeling on the floor together at 01:47
observation.costume_and_props: men wear dark charro suits with embroidered jackets, trousers, and wide-brimmed charro hats; women wear colorful layered folkloric dresses with ruffled skirts, patterned blouses, and matching charro hats
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and weight shifts are obscured by fast movement and distance of the stage

signature_moments.what: couples spinning rapidly with women swinging their colorful skirts outward in wide circles
all dancers drop to their knees on the stage while swinging their hats and skirts over their heads
final pose where men kneel beside women holding their hats in the air and smiling toward the audience
